reply.text:
Holt here. That one's a dosage question for a supplement, and I don't give amounts for supplements or anything else you'd take into your body. Yohimbine is a stimulant-type compound with real effects on heart rate and blood pressure, so the amount has to come from a doctor or pharmacist who knows your history, not from me. Ask them before you start, and if you have any heart, blood pressure or anxiety issues, say so up front.

On the fat loss side, the training is what I can help with. Tell me what you're working on and we'll build your sessions and keep your strength while you lean out.
